About.title: About me
About.name: Zonghan Li
About.intro: I’m pursuing a master’s in artificial intelligence at Jianghan University, researching person re-identification and model distillation. Outside my research, I’ve built a publishing workflow that keeps editors in control and a teaching tool that turns a written prompt into a narrated animation.
honors: Third prize, national finals of the National Collegiate Computer Skills Challenge

experience.company: 鲸能涌动科技有限责任公司
points: Independently took projects from requirements and architecture through front-end development, backend implementation and deployment.

Led the design and development of a publishing workflow from scratch. It collected information on a schedule, populated Feishu Base and generated drafts. Editors reviewed each draft before it moved on to layout and publication.

Developed an agent for educational videos. Claude Sonnet 4.5 turned a prompt into a Python animation script, Manim rendered the visuals, and ChatGPT TTS supplied narration synchronized with the animation.

experience.company: 武汉幂思信息科技有限公司
points: Helped build application pages, tested API integrations with the backend team and wrote developer documentation.
Contributed to backend features and database operations, tuned indexes, tested changes and investigated production issues.

skills.name: Backend services and deployment
skills.description: I build RESTful APIs with Python and FastAPI, including SSE streams, file uploads and asynchronous endpoints. I write Dockerfiles to package applications into Docker images and deploy them behind Nginx.

skills.name: Database design and tuning
skills.description: I design MySQL schemas, model business processes as state machines and work with transactions. I tune SQL queries and indexes, and use snapshots to retain historical data.

skills.name: AI agents
skills.description: I’ve independently built agents with LangGraph and LangChain, bringing retrieval, tool calling and multi-agent collaboration into application workflows.

skills.name: RAG and prompt engineering
skills.description: I build retrieval-augmented applications on pgvector, from document extraction, transformation and loading to vector search and query enhancement. I design and refine prompts for the task at hand.

skills.name: Workflow automation
skills.description: I work with n8n, Coze and Dify to connect content collection, drafting, editorial review and publishing in visual workflows.

skills.name: AI coding tools and extensions
skills.description: I develop with Cursor, Claude Code and Codex. I’m familiar with building and publishing Agent Skills and MCP servers.

personal: I adapt quickly to new projects and can keep development moving when deadlines overlap. While working on an Android project, I independently took a web project from initial research and planning through to launch.

I like learning by building. After starting with traditional development, I began experimenting with vibe coding. I’m also exploring how agents work by developing them myself and trying out local model deployment.
